no_golddata_definition: All180 literal prompts reconstruct exactly from shared SYSTEM, original question, requested field names/types and supplied literal source refs. No gold.data object, gold_facts, forbidden_errors, agent notes or expected verdict is interpolated. Oracle intentionally selects gold source spans; it is a supplied-evidence condition, not an unbiased retrieval arm. Numeric/factual content present in genuine documentation remains intentional input.
scope_notes: All52 final oracle inputs read in full after merge. Function and condition anchors preserve convertToShares, previewDeposit, maxDeposit and rounding-case scope.
Aave16 supplied refs jointly contain flashLoanSimple repayment and revert rule. Kamino04 receives its literal formula; risk-adjusted debt is explicitly fixed by question.

68 is the total exam evidence count:60 support spans for52known plus8 neutral contextual spans forunknown. All60known support spans are covered. Unknown neutral spans need not lie inside neutral intro context.
Unknown oracle refs are neutral document intros and lack private/live/future state. Unknown judgments rest on explicitly missing inputs, not on global absence in documentation.
Gold source selection may make questions easy and supply worked examples; this audit does not claim untouched external generalization or novel reasoning.
No model outputs read/generated, no model imports or installs. This context audit is not a model score or resource permission.
